name: driver-on-call
description: Driver-On-Call: find and hire verified drivers nearby, by the hour, day or week.

scripts.setup: npm install && cd server && npm install && cd ../client && npm install && cd .. && npm run seed
scripts.reset: node -e "for (const d of ['server/data','server/uploads']) require('fs').rmSync(d,{recursive:true,force:true})" && npm run seed
scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c green,cyan "npm run dev --prefix server" "npm run dev --prefix client"
scripts.dev:phone: concurrently -n api,web -c green,cyan "npm run dev --prefix server" "npm run dev:phone --prefix client"
